item.title: Version 1.10.0
item.description:
• Simpler Settings
    Every setting fits without scrolling, two-choice options are switches, and your shortcuts are on the first page.
  • Magpie is now Perch Clipboard
    Same history, same ⌥⌘C.
  • Troubleshoot
    Settings › General › Troubleshoot… shows what’s stopping Perch and how to fix it, and copies a report you can send.
  • Screenshots from any folder
    If your screenshots save somewhere other than the Desktop, Perch now picks them up there too.
  • Snappier Quick Look
    Double-click opens it instantly. Triple-click no longer hides the shelf, and a few rarely used options moved to Smart Perch.
